listings.address: Shop 6, Lakeside Centre, Main Road, Lakeside, Cape Town, 7945

listings.name: Southfield IT and Internet Cafe
listings.address: 136 Victoria Road, Southfield, Cape Town, 7880

listings.name: Steven Johnson Cars
listings.address: Cnr Milner Street and Marine Drive, Paarden Eiland, Cape Town

listings.name: Sticky BBQ

It holds BRC Global Standard certification at the highest AA grade for high-hygiene-risk packaging.

listings.name: Tafelsig Community Centre
listings.address: 1 Olifantshoek Street, Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town

listings.name: The Luxe Beauté Co.
